title: PETA's 'The Art of Breaking Up' opens with emotional roller coaster
summary: Teatro Kapamilya's "The Art of Breaking Up" premiered on Friday at the PETA Theater, offering audiences a roller coaster of emotions through its take on love, heartbreak, and relationships.
